summary: The Independent's Natalie Wilson rounds up seven luxury ski resorts for a five-star winter holiday: Zermatt, Megève, Whistler, Vail, Lech, Ólafsfjörður and Niseko. For each she describes the resort's character and gives a sample chalet or hotel package from a tour operator, with prices, departure dates and cheap return flight options. The resorts are pitched on perks such as private instructors, Michelin dining, spas, heliskiing and après.
one_line: A guide to seven luxury ski resorts worldwide, with sample five-star chalet and hotel packages, prices and flight options for the 2023-24 season.
key_facts: Zermatt in Switzerland has 360km of high-altitude slopes at the foot of the Matterhorn and is car-free.
Ski Solutions offers seven nights at Ulysse 8, a five-star chalet in Zermatt, for £1,565pp on chalet board, with a ski instructor Monday to Friday at no extra cost, departing 13 January 2024.

Megève in France has 400km of slopes; Oxford Ski's Chalet Ariana sleeps up to 10 adults and four children in six en-suite bedrooms with an indoor pool, and costs €14,750 (£12,720) for seven nights from 3 December 2023.
Whistler in Canada is North America's largest ski resort, with over 200 piste runs and a snow season from November to April.
Inghams offers seven nights at the Fairmont Chateau Whistler from £1,559pp based on four adults sharing, including return flights from London Heathrow, departing 1 December 2023.
Vail in Colorado is the third-largest mountain ski resort in the US; Iglu Ski offers seven nights at the ski-in, ski-out Arrabelle in Lionshead Village from £1,888.50pp, departing 2 December 2023.
Lech in Austria has almost 305km of pistes and the White Ring circuit; Bramble Ski's six-bedroom Chalech M sleeps 10 for €46,790 (£40,444) per week.
Chalech M's all-inclusive stay includes a complimentary ski instructor for the first two days and an in-resort driver service until 1am.
Ólafsfjörður in Iceland offers heliskiing across 4,000km of terrain with over 256 marked landings, flyable between March and June.
Scandic Guides sells a five-day heli-assisted ski touring package from €4,990pp (£4,314.69) with two summit heli drops per day and five nights at the Sigló Hotel.
Niseko in Japan, on Hokkaido Island, has 51km of pistes, onsen hot springs and views of Mount Yotei.
Crystal Ski Holidays offers seven nights B&B at the Hilton Niseko Village from £1,994pp including flights from London Heathrow, departing 26 February 2024.
Sample return flights include London Luton to Zurich from £107 with easyJet, Luton to Geneva from £51 with Wizz Air, and London Gatwick to Akureyri from £55 with easyJet.
